summary: Lips to match skin type I: redder, smoother and moister than the skin.
_comment: FITTED (Phase21, RD-P21-2): the lips carry Skin_FitzpatrickI's map and its base_color_const, drawn for MakeHuman_Body_v01, so the colour runs across the lip edge with no line; the lip colour is IN the map (its lip region, feathered into the face), and the lips keep their own finish (roughness, coat). The scatter colour follows the base and the tint (RD-P21-4). Before Phase21: Lip mucosa for skin type I (Phase08 8.2, RD-P08-3): paired with Skin_FitzpatrickI_Clean_Base_s001_v01 by the shared Variant token. SUBSURFACE, as skin, but redder, smoother and moist. Derived from the skin by one rule (sources).
name: Lips_FitzpatrickI_Clean_Base_s001_v01

sources.note: Phase21: the colour is Skin_FitzpatrickI's map x its base_color_const; the map's lip region is the skin's tone x (0.93, 0.68, 0.93) since Phase23 23.2.11 (III's fit's lips: the phase's reference's lips measured over its trunk, gen_synth_skin.LIPS; tones I and II take III's fit, RD-P23-3 as the lead amended it), feathered into the face; before that the derivation rule below (the skin's tone x (0.80, 0.55, 0.60); 0.678, 0.351, 0.331 before Phase21)

sources.why: Phase08 8.2 derivation rule (judgement; no measured lip albedo exists, F-P08-1): lips = the skin's albedo x (0.80, 0.55, 0.60), i.e. the skin's own melanin with blood showing through a thinner stratum corneum (red kept, green and blue drop). On Skin III this gives (0.50, 0.24, 0.21), the shipped Lips_Natural (0.52, 0.26, 0.24) within 0.03. Every other value is Lips_Natural's (roughness 0.35 and coat 0.3 at 0.2, IOR 1.336: MPFB2's lips and a film of saliva); the scatter radius and its per-channel scale are the skin's own (Physically Based). Inputs: Skin_FitzpatrickI_Clean_Base_s001_v01 base_color_const (0.847, 0.638, 0.552).
